description: Inventory of every REST/HTTP-calling function in ScubaGear. Entries whose category begins with 'Out of pattern' are intentionally NOT routed through the central Invoke-ScubaRestMethod/Invoke-GraphDirectly primitives; each entry's notes explain why. This file is also consumed at runtime by Get-ScubaGearRestEndpoint (Modules/Permissions/PermissionsHelper.psm1), which filters by functionName - objects without a functionName (like this one) are ignored.

scope.inScopeDetailed: Functions reachable from the assessment pipeline (Invoke-SCuBA / Invoke-SCuBACached) and the install/update/dependency tooling are inventoried individually.
scope.configAppCoverage: The ScubaConfigApp WPF authoring GUI and the Config Analyzer are a separate interactive subsystem (some calls run in isolated runspaces) and are inventoried at module granularity rather than per call site - one entry per helper module enumerating its HTTP call sites in 'operations'.
scope.repoToolingCoverage: HTTP calls outside the shipped module - the live-tenant functional test harness (Testing/Functional) and repo CI/dev maintainer scripts (utils/workflow, Testing/Functional/SmokeTest, .github/workflows) - are inventoried at wrapper/script granularity under 'Out of pattern - functional test harness' and 'Out of pattern - repo CI/dev tooling' categories so nothing in the repo is undocumented, while remaining clearly distinct from the scan engine.
scope.excluded: Static URL strings in *_Control_*.json UI config files are data, not call sites, and are not inventoried. Unit-test mocks (Testing/Unit) are not call sites and are not inventoried.

description: Generic wrapper around Invoke-RestMethod for authenticated (Bearer token) REST calls. Every non-Graph provider REST helper routes through this function.

parameters.name: BaseUrl
parameters.description: Base URL of the target API.

parameters.name: AccessToken
parameters.description: OAuth2 Bearer token.

parameters.name: Endpoint
parameters.description: API path appended to BaseUrl. Allows an empty string when BaseUrl is already the full URL (e.g. EXO).

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: HTTP method. Default GET.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.description: Request body.

parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description: Content-Type header. Default application/json.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Accept header, if the API requires a non-default value (e.g. SharePoint odata=verbose).

parameters.name: AdditionalHeaders
parameters.description: Extra headers beyond Authorization/Content-Type/Accept (e.g. EXO's Prefer/X-ResponseFormat).

parameters.name: TimeoutSec
parameters.description: Request timeout. 0 (default) uses Invoke-RestMethod's own default.

parameters.name: MaxRetries
parameters.description: Retry attempts on HTTP 429/500/503. Default 0 (no retries, opt-in).

parameters.name: RetryDelaySeconds
parameters.description: Fallback delay for 429 without Retry-After, and initial delay for 500/503 (doubles each attempt). Default 5.

returns: Deserialized response object from Invoke-RestMethod. Throws (preserving the original exception) on failure after retries are exhausted.

retrySupport.backoffStrategy: 429: Retry-After header value or RetryDelaySeconds. 500/503: RetryDelaySeconds, doubling each attempt.

errorHandling: Formats HTTP status/headers/body via inline diagnostic logic before rethrowing. Handles both PS5.1 (System.Net.WebException -> HttpWebResponse) and PS7 (HttpResponseException -> HttpResponseMessage) exception shapes, comparing type names as strings rather than type literals because System.Net.Http is not guaranteed loaded on PS5.1 Desktop.

description: Parses the Retry-After header from an HTTP response object. Handles PS5.1 HttpWebResponse (WebHeaderCollection, string-indexable) and PS7 HttpResponseMessage (strongly-typed RetryConditionHeaderValue) shapes.

parameters.name: HttpResponseObject
parameters.description: The response object to inspect (an exception's .Response property).

parameters.name: DefaultSeconds
parameters.description: Fallback value when no Retry-After header is present or parseable.

returns: int (seconds to wait).
notes: Not independently exported; only reachable from within Invoke-ScubaRestMethod's retry loop.

description: Decides whether a REST failure that produced NO HTTP response object (timeout, DNS blip, connection reset) is transient and worth retrying. Inspects PS5.1 System.Net.WebException.Status and, on PS7, matches exception type names (HttpRequestException/TaskCanceledException/IOException/SocketException) with a message-text fallback.

parameters.name: ErrorRecord
parameters.description: The error record whose .Exception should be inspected.

returns: bool (true if the failure looks transient).
notes: Non-HTTP sibling of Get-RetryAfterSeconds; only reachable from Invoke-ScubaRestMethod's retry loop. Documented for the same completeness reason Get-RetryAfterSeconds is.

description: Calls Microsoft Graph directly via Invoke-MgGraphRequest, resolving the target resource path/headers per-cmdlet from ScubaGearApiCatalog.json (via Get-ScubaGearPermissions -OutAs api/apiheader). Auto-paginates @odata.nextLink and normalizes the response via ConvertFrom-GraphHashtable.
authTokenSource: Ambient Connect-MgGraph session (Invoke-MgGraphRequest manages its own auth context)

parameters.name: Commandlet
parameters.description: The Graph SDK cmdlet name this call stands in for (e.g. Get-MgServicePrincipal); used to look up the REST resource in ScubaGearApiCatalog.json.

parameters.name: M365Environment
parameters.description: commercial | gcc | gcchigh | dod.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: Substituted into the {id} placeholder in the catalog's apiResource path.

parameters.name: QueryParams
parameters.description: Appended as a query string (e.g. $filter, $select).

parameters.name: Body
parameters.description: Request body for POST/PATCH, serialized to JSON.

returns: PowerShell object(s) via ConvertFrom-GraphHashtable, with all pages merged for collection responses.
errorHandling: None beyond what Invoke-MgGraphRequest/Trace-ScubaFunction provide; callers (CommandTracker.TryCommand) catch and log.
notes: This is the one REST-calling function that already had a documented, JSON-driven inventory prior to this catalog (see ScubaGearApiCatalog.json).

description: Calls the Microsoft Graph $batch endpoint to execute multiple sub-requests in one HTTP call, with built-in 429 handling that halves the batch size and retries only the throttled sub-requests.
httpMethods: POST (batch envelope; sub-requests can be any method)
returns: Merged array of sub-request results.

retrySupport.backoffStrategy: Halves the batch size on repeated 429s and retries only the still-throttled sub-requests.

calledBy: AADRiskyPermissionsHelper.psm1 (batch service principal / app role lookups)

description: Invokes an Exchange Online / Security & Compliance cmdlet via the shared adminapi 'InvokeCommand' REST endpoint. A single endpoint + permission serves both the exo and securitysuite products; the specific operation is selected by the CmdletName value in the request body, not by the URL.
endpointPath: N/A - ApiEndpoint is already the full InvokeCommand URL; delegates to Invoke-ScubaRestMethod with -Endpoint ""

parameters.name: CmdletName
parameters.description: The Exchange/Compliance cmdlet to invoke remotely, e.g. Get-RemoteDomain. See 'operations' below.

parameters.name: ApiEndpoint
parameters.description: Fully-qualified InvokeCommand endpoint URI.

parameters.name: AccessToken
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the remote cmdlet.

returns: The .value property of the InvokeCommand JSON response.
errorHandling: Delegates diagnostics to Invoke-ScubaRestMethod; wraps failures as "Exchange Online API call '<CmdletName>' failed: ...".

operations.notes: Fetched independently by both providers; each emits its own accepted_domains JSON key (known duplication, intentionally left alone).

notes: The single biggest duplication target found and fixed in the centralize-invoke-scubarestmethod-retry branch: previously had its own hand-rolled Invoke-WebRequest + retry loop instead of using Invoke-ScubaRestMethod.

description: Shared endpoint-discovery logic for Get-ExchangeOnlineApiEndpoint and Get-ComplianceApiEndpoint. Probes the front-door's EXOModuleFile discovery path (unfollowed GET) and parses the 3xx Location header's host prefix to build the tenant's regional InvokeCommand endpoint.
httpMethods: GET (raw HttpClient probe, not via Invoke-ScubaRestMethod)

parameters.name: FrontDoorBaseUri
parameters.description: Product's front-door base URI.

parameters.name: BackendSuffix
parameters.description: Backend host suffix combined with the discovered regional prefix.

parameters.name: TimeoutSeconds
parameters.description: Default 15.

parameters.name: ThrowOnFailure
parameters.description: EXO: set (fail hard). SecuritySuite/Compliance: unset (falls back to default endpoint with a warning).

returns: The resolved (or default, non-redirected) InvokeCommand endpoint URL.
notes: Extracted from two near-identical ~50-line copies during the centralize-invoke-scubarestmethod-retry branch. Also fixed a pre-existing bug: System.Net.Http was not guaranteed loaded on PS5.1, causing 'Unable to find type [System.Net.Http.HttpClientHandler]' in a fresh process.

description: Resolves DNS TXT records (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) over DoH as a fallback when traditional DNS fails. Iterates a fixed list of public DoH resolvers and uses the first that responds.

parameters.name: (Select-DohServer) <none>
parameters.description: No parameters.

parameters.name: (Invoke-DoH) Qname
parameters.description: Fully-qualified domain name to query for TXT records.

parameters.name: (Invoke-DoH) MaxTries
parameters.description: Retry attempts for the DoH query. Default 2.

returns: Select-DohServer: string - the first reachable of cloudflare-dns.com, [2606:4700:4700::1111], 1.1.1.1, or $null if none respond (Invoke-DoH caches the result in $script:DohServer). Invoke-DoH: hashtable { Answers[], NXDomain (bool), LogEntries[], Errors[] } (declared [OutputType([hashtable])]).
notes: Reviewed for centralization onto Invoke-ScubaRestMethod and explicitly rejected: fail-fast/try-next-server semantics and no Bearer token are fundamentally different from the authenticated-retry pattern Invoke-ScubaRestMethod implements.

parameters.name: (Get-OPAFile) OPAExe
parameters.description: Target filename to save the OPA executable as (alias 'out').

parameters.name: (Get-OPAFile) ExpectedVersion
parameters.description: OPA version to download, x.x.x (alias 'version').

parameters.name: (Get-OPAFile) Filename
parameters.description: Source asset filename on openpolicyagent.org (alias 'name').

parameters.name: (Get-ExeHash) Filename
parameters.description: OPA asset filename whose .sha256 to fetch (alias 'name').

parameters.name: (Get-ExeHash) ExpectedVersion

category: Out of pattern - functional test harness
description: Wrapper around Invoke-WebRequest used by the live-tenant functional test harness to drive a test tenant into known states. Handles long-running operations: on HTTP 202 it polls the Location / Operation-Location / Azure-AsyncOperation header with GET, waiting Retry-After (or DefaultRetryAfterSeconds) between polls.

parameters.name: Uri
parameters.description: Target URI.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: HTTP method.

parameters.name: Headers
parameters.description: Request headers; carries the Bearer token.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.description: Request body; ignored for GET.

parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description: Content-Type; ignored for GET.

parameters.name: DefaultRetryAfterSeconds
parameters.description: Poll delay when no Retry-After header. Default 5.

parameters.name: MaxPollAttempts
parameters.description: Max 202 poll attempts before throwing. Default 10.

returns: Parsed JSON (ConvertFrom-Json) on 2xx; the raw content string if the body isn't JSON; $null if the body is empty. Throws after MaxPollAttempts polls, on a 202 with no polling header, on any non-2xx status, or on a non-HTTP (network/DNS) error (logging details via Get-HttpResponseDetails first). Does NOT retry 429/5xx.
calledBy: Invoke-FunctionalExoRestRequest and the EXO/PowerPlatform/Teams/SPO/PowerBI state-setup helpers in FunctionalTestUtils.ps1
